title: En la gasolinera
subtitle: Paying for gas
scene: You pull up to a pump on the highway. An attendant walks over.

lines.en: Hi. How much should I put in?
lines.note: Buenas is a short, casual hello for any time of day.

culture.title: Gas stations
culture.text: An attendant pumps the gas for you. Check that the pump starts at zero (en ceros) and give a small tip, about 10 to 20 pesos.

lines.es: Lleno, por favor. De la verde.
lines.en: Fill it up, please. The green one.
lines.note: Regular gas (Magna) usually has a green handle; Premium is red.

lines.es: Muy bien. Está en ceros, joven.
lines.en: All right. It’s at zero, young man.
No, thanks. Do you take cards?
Yes, of course. That’s eight hundred pesos.

lines.es: Aquí tiene. Y esto es para usted.
lines.en: Here you go. And this is for you.
lines.note: What to say as you hand over the tip.

lines.en: Thanks, young man. Have a good trip!
